ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A screen with Alexa would complement my Fire TV devices and could be useful for viewing compatible security cameras.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa fits my setup, but I would choose the Show 8 for its screen this time.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my Alexa setup, but I prefer the Show 8's larger screen and would only choose one.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: OontZ Angle 3 Bluetooth Speaker, Portable Wireless Bluetooth 5.0 Speaker, 10 Watts, Crystal Clear Stereo Sound, Rich Bass, IPX5 Water Resistant, Loud Portable Bluetooth Speaker (Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently looking for a portable speaker.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The doorbell interests me because I already use Blink, but I would wait until I need more coverage before buying a whole bundle.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: WYZE Cam v2 - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have Foscam and Blink cameras and have no immediate reason to add another camera system.
